trigger: at least one printed band inside the window
requires: at least one carbon-oxygen double bond
note: Ketone, aldehyde, ester, acid, amide, urea, carbamate, anhydride, acyl halide. Not nitro (N=O) and not sulfoxide (S=O). Absence of a band is not a constraint: printed lists omit peaks.

trigger: at least one printed band inside the window
requires: at least one hydrogen on oxygen or nitrogen
note: Alcohol, phenol, carboxylic acid, amine, amide, oxime. A terminal alkyne C-H stretch also falls near 3300 and is not an O-H or N-H. The rule is applied as stated; the post-hoc gold audit measures how often that costs the true structure.

trigger: at least one printed band inside the window
requires: a nitrile, alkyne, isocyanate, isothiocyanate, or azide
note: The 2100-2260 cm-1 window is the nitrile and alkyne stretch. The same window also contains isocyanates, isothiocyanates, and azides. Those substructures are accepted so the rule matches the window rather than only two of the groups that absorb there.
